sections.text_helper: Section 40.9.13 "CSI-2 Host interrupt enable register 1 (CSI_IER1)" in chapter 40 (CSI-2 Host (CSI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2056.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x84
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 ECTRLDL1IE: D-PHY_RX lane 1 control error interrupt enable
This bit enables the D-PHY_RX control error interrupt detected on lane 1 consecutive to
anincorrect line state sequence.
0: Lane 1 control error interrupt disabled
1: Lane 1 control error interrupt enabled
Bit 11 ESYNCESCDL1IE: D-PHY_RX lane 1 low-power data transmission synchronization error
interrupt enable
This bit enables the interrupt generation when the number of bits received during a
low-power data transmission is not a multiple of eight when the transmission ends on lane 1.
0: Lane 1 low-power data transmission interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 1 low-power data transmission Interrupt error enabled
Bit 10 EESCDL1IE: D-PHY_RX lane 1 escape entry error interrupt enable
This bit enables the interrupt generation when an unrecognized escape entry command is
received on lane 1.
0: Lane 1 unrecognized escape entry command interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 1 unrecognized escape entry command interrupt error enabled
Bit 9 ESOTSYNCDL1IE: SOT synchronization interrupt error enable on lane 1
This bit enables the interrupt generation when the high-speed SOT leader sequence is
corrupted in a such way that the proper synchronization cannot be expected.
0: Lane 1 SOT synchronization interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 1 SOT synchronization interrupt error enabled
Bit 8 ESOTDL1IE: SOT error interrupt enable on lane 1
This bit enables the interrupt generation when the high-speed SOT leader sequence is
corrupted in a such way that the proper synchronization can still be achieved.
0: Lane 1 SOT interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 1 SOT interrupt error enabled
Bits 7:5 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 4 ECTRLDL0IE: D-PHY_RX lane 0 control error interrupt enable
This bit enables the D-PHY_RX control error interrupt detected on lane 0 consecutive to
anincorrect line state sequence.
0: Lane 0 control error interrupt disabled
1: Lane 0 control error interrupt enabled
Bit 3 ESYNCESCDL0IE: D-PHY_RX lane 0 low power data transmission synchronization error
interrupt enable
This bit enables the interrupt generation when the number of bits received during a
low-power data transmission is not a multiple of eight when the transmission ends on lane 1.
0: Lane 0 low-power data transmission interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 0 low-power data transmission Interrupt error enabled
Bit 2 EESCDL0IE: D-PHY_RX lane 0 escape entry error interrupt enable
This bit enables the interrupt generation when an unrecognized escape entry command is
received on lane 0.
0: Lane 0 unrecognized escape entry command interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 0 unrecognized escape entry command interrupt error enabled
Bit 1 ESOTSYNCDL0IE: SOT synchronization interrupt error enable on lane 0
This bit enables the interrupt generation when the high-speed SOT leader sequence is
corrupted in a such way that the proper synchronization cannot be expected.
0: Lane 0 SOT synchronization interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 0 SOT synchronization interrupt error enabled
Bit 0 ESOTDL0IE: SOT error interrupt enable on lane 0
This bit enables the interrupt generation when the high-speed SOT leader sequence is
corrupted in a such way that the proper synchronization can still be achieved.
0: Lane 0 SOT interrupt error disabled
1: Lane 0 SOT interrupt error enabled
